facts.fact: A SADCAS accreditation certificate dated 14 December 2025 describes the Malawi Bureau of Standards as established by the Malawi Bureau of Standards Act (Cap 51:02); it names no national standard on information technology or data.

systems.system: Malawi Bureau of Standards, Quality Management Systems Certification (QMS-CERT-003)

note: No certification fact: SADCAS accredits MBS to certify quality management systems only (ISO/IEC 17021-1 and -3; scope food, rubber and plastics, transport and storage), not against an IT or data standard.

facts.fact: The Malawi Bureau of Standards Act, No. 14 of 2012 (assented 12 July 2012, published 27 July 2012), establishes the Malawi Bureau of Standards as a body corporate with the object of preparing and issuing standards, under a Malawi Standards Board; the captured text names no standard on information technology or data.

note: Excerpt only: sections on the standards themselves were not captured, so no published-standard fact; the Bureau's power to assess quality systems and administer certification (s.4) names no IT or data standard.

facts.fact: ISO's member page says the Malawi Bureau of Standards is the national standards body responsible for preparing and publishing Malawi standards.
